serverInfo.name: kar-citelock
serverInfo.title: Kar CiteLock: claims checked against their sources

result.instructions: Call verify_claim with a claim and the sources it rests on, before you state the claim. It answers VERIFIED only when every quotation in the claim is word for word in a cited source and every content word and number is in a cited source; otherwise REFUSED, with one reason for each part that failed, and the trace of every check with its offsets. It checks words, numbers and offsets; it does not understand meaning. Call about for the rules and limits.
